AISHELL.recording_evidence: 400 invited participants; indoor microphone recordings downsampled to 16kHz; professional human annotation
AISHELL.attribution: Beijing Shell Shell Technology Co., Ltd.; Hui Bu, Jiayu Du, Xingyu Na, Bengu Wu, Hao Zheng (2017), AIShell-1: An Open-Source Mandarin Speech Corpus and A Speech Recognition Baseline

LibriSpeech.recording_evidence: read English speech derived from LibriVox audiobooks
LibriSpeech.attribution: Vassil Panayotov, Guoguo Chen, Daniel Povey, Sanjeev Khudanpur (2015), LibriSpeech: an ASR corpus based on public domain audio books

transformations: No local audio modification: exact WAV bytes from pinned WeNet fixtures. Original corpus audio may have been converted to WAV upstream; no claim of bit identity to original full corpus archives. References copied verbatim from pinned WeNet dataset/text.
selection: Two pre-existing fixtures selected by language before recognition. One Mandarin and one English utterance; not representative or held-out validation. Excludes private recordings and speaker identities.
limitations: Google FLEURS official GCS/HF fetch blocked by current network policy (403); no bypass attempted.
Repository license is not substituted for original corpus licensing: OpenSLR original corpus declarations checked independently.
No audio is committed to product repository.
